trees.title: WB_SetAdultChildCount
trees.value:
<%= 
# Parse Family Members
family_members = JSON.parse(@inputs["Family Members JSON"]) 

def count_adults_and_children(people)
  total_adults = 0
  total_children = 0

  people.each do |person|
    case person["Type"]
    when "Adult"
      total_adults += 1
    when "Child"
      total_children += 1
    end
  end

  { adults: total_adults, children: total_children }
end
count_adults_and_children(family_members).to_json %>
